documents.title: Synthetic equipment distractor
documents.text: Synthetic workshop audio equipment is not described in the available venue options. Equipment availability must be confirmed separately.

documents.title: Synthetic older cancellation draft
documents.text: Older draft cancellation guidance: cancel a workshop booking at least 3 calendar days before the event for a full refund. This draft is not the current official policy.

documents.title: Synthetic current workshop cancellation policy
documents.text: Synthetic fixture cancellation policy: cancel a workshop booking at least 7 calendar days before the event for a full refund. Cancellations fewer than 7 days before the event are refundable only according to the booking terms.

documents.title: Synthetic workshop catering options
documents.text: Synthetic fixture catering options: the standard package includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian lunch, tea, and coffee. Dietary requests should be submitted with the booking.

documents.title: Synthetic Pune outside-catering restriction
documents.text: Synthetic Venue A in Pune does not allow outside catering. The standard package remains vegetarian and non-vegetarian lunch with tea and coffee.

documents.title: Synthetic parking distractor
documents.text: Synthetic workshop parking information is not specified in the available venue options. Ask the organiser separately about parking.

documents.title: Synthetic schedule distractor
documents.text: Synthetic workshop schedule notes mention morning and afternoon sessions. The event schedule must be confirmed separately.

documents.title: Synthetic Mumbai venue distractor
documents.text: Venue A in Mumbai accommodates up to 60 attendees and includes a projector. Venue A in Mumbai is a separate entity from Venue A in Pune.

documents.title: Synthetic workshop venue options
documents.text:
Venue A in Pune accommodates up to 30 attendees. Venue A includes a projector and a small breakout room.

Venue B in Pune accommodates up to 40 attendees and includes a projector. Availability must be confirmed separately.
